clips.send: In a video game your score is minus 30 and your friend’s is minus 50. Who is winning? Temperatures below freezing, depths below sea level, money you owe: all of them need numbers less than 0. Starting from a thermometer, the animation extends the number line to the left of 0, then shows opposites, absolute value, and how to compare negative numbers.

clips.send: The three rules in one place. Opposites: a and negativea are the same distance from 0. Absolute value: |a| is that distance, so |a| equals |negativea| . Order: a is less than b exactly when a is to the left of b .
clips.text: The three rules in one place. Opposites: a and negative a are the same distance from 0. Absolute value: |a| is that distance, so |a| equals |-a| . Order: a < b exactly when a is to the left of b .

clips.send: Watch out: negative6 has the larger absolute value, because it is farther from 0. But it is the smaller number. Being farther left always means smaller, no matter how far from zero.
clips.text: Watch out: negative 6 has the larger absolute value, because it is farther from 0. But it is the smaller number. Being farther left always means smaller, no matter how far from zero.

clips.send: On a number line, numbers get greater as you move right. negative2 is to the right of negative6 , so negative2 is greater than negative6 . Think temperature: negative2 degrees C is warmer than negative6 degrees C.
clips.text: On a number line, numbers get greater as you move right. negative 2 is to the right of negative 6 , so negative 2 > negative 6 . Think temperature: negative 2^ degrees C is warmer than negative 6^ degrees C.

clips.send: Worked example: order negative5, 3, negative1, 0, negative7, 6 from least to greatest. Drop each number onto the line, then read from left to right: negative7 is less than negative5 is less than negative1 is less than 0 is less than 3 is less than 6 .
clips.text: Worked example: order negative 5, 3, negative 1, 0, negative 7, 6 from least to greatest. Drop each number onto the line, then read from left to right: negative 7 < negative 5 < negative 1 < 0 < 3 < 6 .

clips.send: The absolute value |a| is a number’s distance from 0. negative5 is 5 steps from zero, so |negative5| equals 5 ; and |5| equals 5 too. A distance is never negative.
clips.text: The absolute value |a| is a number’s distance from 0. negative 5 is 5 steps from zero, so |-5| equals 5 ; and |5| equals 5 too. A distance is never negative.

clips.send: 绝对值 |a| 表示一个数到 0 的距离。 负5 离 0 有 5 格，所以 |负5| 等于 5 ； |5| 也等于 5。距离永远不会是负数。
clips.text: 绝对值 |a| 表示一个数到 0 的距离。 负5 离 0 有 5 格，所以 |-5| 等于 5 ； |5| 也等于 5。距离永远不会是负数。

clips.send: 把竖直的刻度横过来，就得到一条向 0 的左边继续延伸的数轴。正数在 0 的右边，负数在 0 的左边，0 既不是正数也不是负数。
clips.text: 把竖直的刻度横过来，就得到一条向 0 的左边继续延伸的数轴。正数在 0 的右边，负数在 0 的左边，0 既不是正数也不是负数。

clips.send: 在数轴上，越往右数越大。 负2 在 负6 的右边，所以 负2 大于 负6 。想想气温： 负2 度 C 比 负6 度 C 暖和。
clips.text: 在数轴上，越往右数越大。 负2 在 负6 的右边，所以 负2 > 负6 。想想气温： 负2^ 度 C 比 负6^ 度 C 暖和。

clips.send: 把三条规律放在一起。相反数： a 与 负a 到 0 的距离相同。绝对值： |a| 就是这个距离，所以 |a| 等于 |负a| 。大小： a 在 b 的左边，就有 a 小于 b 。
clips.text: 把三条规律放在一起。相反数： a 与 负a 到 0 的距离相同。绝对值： |a| 就是这个距离，所以 |a| 等于 |-a| 。大小： a 在 b 的左边，就有 a < b 。
